sources.title: What It Takes to Train AI for Finance: Inside FIBI's Development Process
sources.snippet: Challenges, Learnings & Surprises Like any breakthrough project, building FIBI, came with its challenges. Adapting the model to interpret technical financial language, designing a personalized response for a diverse user base, while ensuring every output was both accurate and relevant were top hurdles.
